panel.heading: Simulation

state.scheduled: Waiting for your edits to settle.
state.ready: This describes the circuit on screen.

panel.support: Basis states with a non-zero probability

moment.start: The state before column 0 runs — where the circuit starts.
moment.column: The state after column {{column}}, not at the end of the circuit.

noise.measuring: This circuit measures before it ends, so it has no single ideal distribution — and the noise mode compares a noisy distribution against an ideal one. Remove the measurements to compare them.

errors.too-many-qubits: This circuit has {{qubits}} qubits. The browser simulates up to {{limit}}; past that the state no longer fits in a tab.
errors.invalid-circuit: This circuit does not match the format the simulator expects.
errors.measurement-in-analytic-mode: This circuit measures before it ends, so it has no single final state. Run it in sampling mode to see the counts.
errors.no-classical-bits: Sampling reports the classical register, and this circuit declares no classical bits. Add a measurement first.
errors.unsupported-operation: The simulator cannot run one of the gates in this circuit yet.
errors.worker-unavailable: This browser could not start the simulator. Simulation runs on a separate thread, and this page failed to create one.
errors.worker-failed: The simulator stopped unexpectedly. Edit the circuit to try again.
errors.density-too-large: A density matrix for {{qubits}} qubits is past the {{limit}}-qubit ceiling of the noise mode. Sampled trajectories reach further, because they hold a statevector rather than a matrix.
errors.trajectories-too-large: A sampled noisy run re-runs the whole circuit once per shot, so at {{qubits}} qubits and {{operations}} gates this browser could afford only {{shots}} shots — below the {{limit}} a sample needs to mean anything. Shorten the circuit or use fewer qubits.
errors.noise-out-of-memory: This device could not reserve the memory the exact method needs for {{qubits}} qubits, even though it is inside the {{limit}}-qubit ceiling. Sampled trajectories need far less: they hold a statevector rather than a matrix.
errors.noise-failed: The noisy run did not finish. Everything above it describes the circuit as written and is unaffected.
errors.server-unavailable: Server simulation is unavailable right now. This circuit is past what the browser can hold, so there is nothing to show until it comes back.
errors.server-too-large: The server refused this circuit: it is past a resource limit. Try fewer qubits, a shorter circuit, or fewer shots.
errors.server-refused: The server did not accept this run. Nothing was simulated.
errors.sampling-too-large: A sampling run re-runs the whole circuit once per shot, so {{shots}} shots of a {{qubits}}-qubit circuit with {{operations}} gates would take minutes in this tab — and a server would refuse work this size too. Use fewer qubits or a shorter circuit.

server.heading: Run on the server
server.why: This circuit has {{qubits}} qubits. The browser simulates up to {{limit}}, so this one was sent to a server — which is why it takes seconds rather than milliseconds.

state.queued: Waiting in the queue for a worker.

server.offline: The progress feed dropped and is reconnecting. The run is unaffected; this page keeps checking on it.
server.stopNote: The run keeps going on the server and keeps its identifier — this only stops this page waiting for it.
server.summary: {{qubits}} qubits, seed {{seed}}, {{milliseconds}} ms of engine time.
server.hidden: {{states}} further basis states are not listed; between them they carry {{weight}} of the probability.
server.noResult: The run finished but stored no readable result.

table.caption: Basis states the server reported, largest first

failure.INVALID_CIRCUIT: The server refused this circuit: it does not match the format the simulator expects.
failure.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The server refused this run: it is past a resource limit — the qubit ceiling, the gate count, the shots, or the time one run may take.
failure.TIMED_OUT: The run was still going when its time limit expired, and was stopped. Try fewer qubits, a shorter circuit, or fewer shots.
failure.RESULT_TOO_LARGE: The answer was too large to store. A register this size has more basis states than a stored result can carry.
failure.ENGINE_FAILED: The simulation engine failed on the server. That is a bug in this project rather than a problem with your circuit.
failure.WORKER_CRASHED: The process running this simulation died without answering — most likely it ran out of memory.
failure.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: The run was accepted but never reached a worker, so nothing ran it.
failure.UNKNOWN: The run did not finish, and the server gave no reason this page knows how to explain.

server.stopped: You stopped waiting. The run keeps going on the server and keeps its identifier.
server.stoppedWithId: You stopped waiting. The run keeps going on the server as {{runId}}.
